# Motion acceptance fixture pages (Spec 38A M2.9)

Block trees for `scripts/wp-build-page.js`, probed by `plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-model.mjs`. The probe finds each page by its `.m29-*` marker classes, so any page ID built from these trees works. Build with `--create page` (never over the motion-QA fixture pages), then record the new IDs in `.claude/rules/motion-qa.md`.

- `hover-entrance.json`: a first-section heading with a page-load entrance (`.m29-load-first`, LCP rule), a later page-load entrance that fades (`.m29-load-later`), an info-box card with a hover lift, scale, token duration and colour hover (`.m29-hover-card`) beside a plain control card (`.m29-plain-card`), and a container whose inner part has a below-the-fold Fade up on a distance token with a stored 200 ms entrance delay (`.m29-fade-part`; the card also stores a 100 ms hover delay, so the reduced-motion delay check reads non-zero under no-preference) beside an unanimated sibling (`.m29-fade-sibling`).
- `keyframes-tilt.json`: a below-the-fold three-keyframe entrance with a stored 500 ms delay (`.m29-kf`) beside a sibling with none, a heading with both a scroll entrance and a hover lift (`.m29-both`), and an info-box with the legacy 3D tilt (`.m29-tilt`, class `sgs-has-tilt-3d` from `sgsHoverTilt3D`).
- `no-motion.json`: a heading and text with no motion at all (`.m29-nomotion`), for the check that no motion stylesheet or script loads.
- `motion-per-device.json` (M3.9, canary page 5244): an entrance with Desktop 24px, Tablet 16px and Mobile 8px translate distances and a copy with Mobile cleared, hovers with a custom `cubic-bezier()` and a `linear()` easing, an `sgs/team-member` whose photo part alone moves on a whole-block hover, three tilted cards each at its own rest angle that straighten on hover, and a polaroid frame (markers `.m39-*`). Probed by `scripts/motion-qa/probe-motion-per-device.mjs` (FR-38A-4, 12, 13, 42).
